$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=3 x^{2} - 4\,⟹\,\text{d}u=(3 x^{2} - 4)\,\text{d}x,
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{3 x^{2} - 4}{x^{3} - 4 x}\,\text{d}x & =\int \frac{1}{x^{3} - 4 x}\cdot (3 x^{2} - 4)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int \frac{1}{u}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\operatorname{ln}|u|+C \\  & =\operatorname{ln}\left|x^{3} - 4 x\right|+C\end{aligned}
$$
